big_case.notes: A private paid petition asking the Court to extend Padilla v. Kentucky beyond deportation to civil False Claims Act exposure, on 2255 collateral review with an independent retroactivity ground below; the United States waived, the petition was denied on the first order list after the Long Conference without a noted dissent, and it drew no amicus or press attention. The abstract doctrinal question (the direct/collateral line after Padilla) has real reach, but this vehicle's stakes were confined to two petitioners' civil judgment. Formed from the record and the denial; see evaluation.md on anchoring.
